```python
from pptx import Presentation

path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/a3fbeb63-0e8c-4a11-bff6-0e3b484c3e9c.pptx"

def extract_all_text(p):
    prs = Presentation(p)
    slides_out = []
    for i, slide in enumerate(prs.slides, start=1):
        texts = []
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            if hasattr(shape, "text") and shape.text:
                texts.append(shape.text)
            # attempt alt text
            if hasattr(shape, "alternative_text") and shape.alternative_text:
                texts.append(shape.alternative_text)
        # notes
        if slide.has_notes_slide:
            ntf = slide.notes_slide.notes_text_frame
            if ntf and ntf.text:
                texts.append(ntf.text)
        slides_out.append((i, " ".join(texts).strip()))
    return slides_out

slides = extract_all_text(path)
for num, txt in slides:
    print(f"Slide {num}: {txt}\n")
```
